text:
Carmen: Quick sync — were prepping a short paid push: search price anchors + a retarget carousel that drives webinar signups. Goal: CPL <= $30 for search, CPL <= $18 for webinar. Can ops lock LP variants by EOD? :clock1:

Leo: Yep. Ill spin two LPs: webinar-gated and webinar-direct. Sending links in 30m.

Priya: Creative ask: 4 carousel cards, 3 price-anchor headlines, 2 stat overlays. Keep headlines <= 30 chars. Ill drop copy to Drive.

Tom: Budget plan: $1,200/day. Allocate $700 search, $400 retarget, $100 branded. Pacing: +10% T+6h, +10% T+24h if CPA within target.

ads-bot: preflight: campaign-config OK. Health hooks: /alerts/marketing/price_anchor_flow. Will run hourly checks post-launch.

Carmen: Include exclusion list: last_30d_converters + current_webinar_signups. Also attach creative_id in utm_content.

Leo: Noted. UTM template: ?utm_source=paid&utm_medium=search&utm_campaign=price_anchor&utm_content=creative_{{id}}

Priya: Quick copy options (pick 1 per ad):
- "Starts at $99/mo. Try free."
- "From $99 or less."
- "See pricing for teams."

Tom: If any channel CPA > 30% of target, auto-pause that channel and ping @Carmen @Leo.

Carmen: Good. Final review 7pm PT. If green we launch tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks all! :rocket:
